definitions.gloss: iron fist; hard punch; a blow with a clenched fist
definitions.explanation: Literally 'iron fist'. Refers to a powerful punch or blow with the fist. Used figuratively for forceful, authoritarian control or discipline.

examples.japanese: {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄拳|てっけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|おさ}めた→治める：02462_osameru⟧。
examples.english: The leader ruled the country with an iron fist.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体罰|たいばつ}→体罰：11568_taibatsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{鉄拳|てっけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{用|もち}いられる→用いる：02314_mochiiru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、今⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許容|きょよう}→許容：14172_kyoyou⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the past, physical punishment with the fist was sometimes used, but it is no longer acceptable today.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron) + {拳|けん} (fist). Used both literally (a powerful punch) and figuratively (harsh, domineering control).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧: iron-fisted punishment; a blow as punishment
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧: to swing an iron fist; to use force
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{治|おさ}める→治める：02462_osameru⟧: to rule with an iron fist
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう: to receive a punch as punishment

NOTE: {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧ is the most common fixed compound — physical punishment as a form of discipline, now generally considered unacceptable.
